GlobalTheory.Mem.An.LogDerOne: There is $C$ such that $\bigl|\tfrac{L'}{L}(1,\chi)-\sum_\rho\tfrac1{1-\rho}\bigr|\le C\log 3q$ for every primitive $\chi$ modulo $q>1$, the sum over the zeros with $0<\re\rho<1$ and $\abs{\im\rho}\le1$.
GlobalTheory.Published.EllipticMainTheor: The main theorem of complex multiplication for elliptic curves with CM by an imaginary quadratic field $K$, in idelic form: if $\sigma\in\mathrm{Aut}(\C/K)$ restricts to $\mathrm{Art}(s)$, then $\sigma$ transports an analytic uniformisation $\C/\mathfrak a\to E(\C)$ according to the finite part of $s$.
GlobalTheory.Published.HeckeTateFunction: For a unitary Hecke character $\chi$ of a totally complex field with non-zero infinity type relative to a CM type, the completed $L$-functions of $\chi$ and $\chi^{-1}$ exist and $\Lambda(s,\chi)=\varepsilon_\infty\,\varepsilon_{\mathrm f}(s)\,\Lambda(1-s,\chi^{-1})$.
GlobalTheory.Published.HilbertClassField: For $K$ imaginary quadratic, $K(j(\cO_K))$ is the Hilbert class field, of degree $h_K$; $j(\mathfrak a)=j(\mathfrak b)$ exactly when the ideal classes agree; and the $h_K$ values $j(\mathfrak a)$ are the conjugates of $j(\cO_K)$ over $K$.
GlobalTheory.Published.PartialZetaFuncti: For $F$ totally real of degree $n$ and ideal classes $C,C'$ whose product is the class of the different: $d_F^{s/2}\Gamma_\R(s)^n\zeta(s,C)=d_F^{(1-s)/2}\Gamma_\R(1-s)^n\zeta(1-s,C')$.
GlobalTheory.Published.DeligneRibet: For $F$ totally real and a $\Q$-valued function $\varepsilon$ on ideals that is constant on narrow ray classes modulo $\ell^n$ and $\ell$-integral: $L(1-k,\varepsilon)-N\mathfrak c^{k}L(1-k,\varepsilon(\mathfrak c\,\cdot))$ is $\ell$-integral, for $\mathfrak c$ prime to $\ell$ and $k\ge1$.
GlobalTheory.Published.SiegelKlingenDeli: The preceding statement together with the theorem of Siegel and Klingen.
GlobalTheory.Mem.LiteralAutomorphy.JoinO: A conjunction of five statements internal to the archive, on critical values of Hecke $L$-functions of CM fields and on partial zeta values.
GlobalTheory.HeightCounting.HtCard: For a continuous $\ell$-adic representation of dimension $a$ of the Galois group of the host field that is de Rham at a place $w$ above $\ell$, and an embedding $\tau$ inducing $w$: the multiset of $\tau$-Hodge--Tate weights has $a$ elements.
GlobalTheory.Published.AbMulNSt: An abelian variety of dimension $g$ over an algebraically closed field has exactly $n^{2g}$ points killed by $n$, for $n$ invertible in the field.
GlobalTheory.Published.AbelianDeRham: For an abelian scheme $A$ of relative dimension $g$ over a ring $R$: $H^1_{\mathrm{dR}}(A/R)$ is finite projective of rank $2g$ and cup product identifies its second exterior power with $H^2_{\mathrm{dR}}$; the submodule of primitive classes is a direct summand, finite projective of rank $g$; both are compatible with base change; the comparison map along a nilpotent divided-power thickening is bijective; and the pairing of a polarisation vanishes on the filtration and is perfect when the polarisation has trivial kernel.
GlobalTheory.Published.DeRhamPotSemistab: Every continuous de Rham representation of the Galois group of a finite extension of $\Q_\ell$ is potentially semistable.
GlobalTheory.Published.GlobalArtinRecipr: For every number field $E$ there is a homomorphism $\mathbb A_E^\times\to G_E^{\mathrm{ab}}$ with the properties of the global Artin map.
GlobalTheory.Published.HeckeLAdicCharact: The $\ell$-adic character attached to an algebraic Hecke character is de Rham at every place above $\ell$, with Hodge--Tate weights given by the infinity type.
GlobalTheory.Published.AlgebraicCharacte: Local--global compatibility for algebraic Hecke characters at every finite place, including those above $\ell$: the Weil--Deligne representation of the $\ell$-adic character at $w$ is the local component composed with the local Artin map.
GlobalTheory.Published.ArCalc: Seven properties of arithmetic intersection numbers of Hermitian line bundles.
GlobalTheory.Published.ArDegree: Two statements on arithmetic intersection numbers and Chern degrees.
GlobalTheory.Published.Principalisation: For a smooth projective integral variety over a field of characteristic $0$ and a non-zero ideal sheaf $I$: a sequence of blow-ups in smooth centres over the support of $I$ is an isomorphism away from the support and turns $I$ into an effective Cartier divisor with simple normal crossings.
GlobalTheory.Published.ArithHilbertSamue: For a nef Hermitian line bundle $\bar L$ of arithmetic self-intersection $a$ on an arithmetic variety of relative dimension $D$, and any $\bar N$: the number of sections of $\bar L^{m}\otimes\bar N$ of sup-norm at most $1$ is finite for large $m$ and its logarithm is $\tfrac{a}{(D+1)!}m^{D+1}+o(m^{D+1})$.
GlobalTheory.Published.AutomorphicFormsF: Over a totally complex field, the automorphic forms on $\GL_a$ of a given level, $K_\infty$-type and infinitesimal character span a finite-dimensional space.
GlobalTheory.Published.BaseChangeIsobari: Base change from a definite unitary group to an isobaric sum on $\GL_n$.
GlobalTheory.Published.BaseChangeDefinit: The same with the full induced product as local component.
GlobalTheory.Published.BernsteinUnitaryP: Over a non-archimedean local field, the parabolically induced product of two irreducible unitarisable smooth representations of general linear groups is irreducible.
GlobalTheory.Published.BernsteinZelevins: For $\GL_n$ over a non-archimedean local field: irreducible smooth representations are admissible; Jacquet functors and parabolic induction preserve finite length; and induction commutes with the contragredient.
GlobalTheory.Published.BhattScholzeInteg: For $K/\Q_\ell$ finite, every lattice in a crystalline representation of $G_K$ is the \'etale realisation of a prismatic $F$-crystal on $\cO_K$, and the realisation is fully faithful.
GlobalTheory.Published.BhattScholzeCryst: The same for lattices with coefficients in the ring of integers of a finite extension of $\Q_\ell$.
GlobalTheory.Published.BlochKatoLocal: For $K/\Q_\ell$ finite: the dimension formula for the Bloch--Kato subspace $H^1_f$ of a de Rham representation, and its duality with that of the Tate dual, rationally and integrally.
GlobalTheory.Published.BorelCasselman: For an admissible representation of $\GL_n$ over a non-archimedean local field, the Iwahori-fixed vectors map bijectively onto the fixed vectors of the Jacquet module.
GlobalTheory.Published.BrauerDegreeZero: For a representation $\rho$ of a finite group, $\chi_\rho-\dim\rho$ is an integral combination of differences $\mathrm{Ind}(\chi_i)-\mathrm{Ind}(1)$ with $\chi_i$ characters of degree one of subgroups.
GlobalTheory.Published.CMCurveGoodOutsid: For a prime $p\equiv3\pmod4$, $p>3$, there is an elliptic curve over $\Q(j(\cO_K))$, $K=\Q(\sqrt{-p})$, with complex multiplication by $\cO_K$, good reduction outside $p$ and minimal discriminant $-p^3$.
GlobalTheory.Published.EssSquareIntegrab: Over a non-archimedean local field of characteristic $0$, an irreducible smooth representation of $\GL_n$ is essentially square-integrable exactly when it is the quotient $L(\Delta)$ attached to a segment.
GlobalTheory.Published.LocalConverseGL: Over a non-archimedean local field of characteristic $0$: two irreducible cuspidal representations of $\GL_n$, $n\ge2$, with the same Rankin--Selberg $\varepsilon$-constants against every irreducible representation of $\GL_{n-1}$ are isomorphic.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.RecTExists: At every finite place of a number field there is a map from the irreducible smooth representations of the groups $\GL_n$ to Weil--Deligne representations satisfying a stated list of laws of the local Langlands correspondence.
UpperTheory.GalS.PairUAlt: For a CM field $E$ and a regular algebraic cuspidal representation $\pi$ of $\GL_a$ forming a polarised pair, there is a continuous semisimple $r\colon G_E\to\GL_a(\overline{\Q}_\ell)$ attached to $\pi$ with stated compatibilities.
GlobalTheory.Published.CuspFormsBoundedG: Over a totally complex field, a cusp form on $\GL_a$ whose absolute value is invariant under the split centre is bounded.
GlobalTheory.Published.JacquetShalikaRig: Over a totally complex field, two finite families of cuspidal automorphic representations of general linear groups whose isobaric sums have the same Satake parameters at almost all places coincide up to permutation.
GlobalTheory.Published.GelfandKazhdanDua: Over a totally complex field, every cuspidal automorphic representation of $\GL_n$ is paired with itself twisted by $g\mapsto{}^{t}g^{-1}$.
GlobalTheory.Published.GenericUnlinkedGL: Over a non-archimedean local field of characteristic $0$, every irreducible generic representation of $\GL_N$ is an irreducible product $L(\Delta_1)\times\dots\times L(\Delta_h)$ over pairwise unlinked segments.
GlobalTheory.Published.ChevalleyUnits: For a number field $E$ and $m,b>0$ there is $a>0$ prime to $b$ such that every unit congruent to $1$ modulo $a$ is an $m$-th power of a unit.
GlobalTheory.Published.GeometricLemma: The geometric lemma of Bernstein and Zelevinsky for $\GL_n$ over a non-archimedean local field: the Jacquet module of an induced representation has a finite filtration by cell functors, with a statement on semisimplifications.
GlobalTheory.Published.GrothendieckRingP: Over a non-archimedean local field, for any assignment $Z(\Delta)$ of segment classes, the Grothendieck group of finite-length representations of all $\GL_n$ is, with the induction product, the polynomial ring on the $Z(\Delta)$.
GlobalTheory.Published.SegmentRepresenta:
Over a non-archimedean local field, the segment product $\sigma	imes\sigma
u	imes\dots	imes\sigma
u^{l-1}$ of a cuspidal $\sigma$ has a unique irreducible subrepresentation, with Jacquet module $\sigma\otimes\sigma
u\otimes\dots\otimes\sigma
u^{l-1}$.
GlobalTheory.Published.ZelevinskyPolynom: Over a non-archimedean local field there are segment classes $Z(\Delta)$ and an isomorphism of the Grothendieck ring of the groups $\GL_n$ with $\Z[X_\Delta]$ sending $Z(\Delta)$ to $X_\Delta$.
GlobalTheory.Published.DepthZeroInductio: Over a non-archimedean local field of characteristic $0$: if every member of the cuspidal support of an irreducible representation of $\GL_n$ has a non-zero vector fixed by the first congruence subgroup, so has the representation.
GlobalTheory.Published.LanglandsExhausti: Over a non-archimedean local field of characteristic $0$, every irreducible smooth representation of $\GL_n$ is $L(\mathfrak m)$ for a multisegment $\mathfrak m$.
GlobalTheory.Published.LanglandsMultiseg: Over a non-archimedean local field of characteristic $0$: the multisegment $\mathfrak m$ of $L(\mathfrak m)$ is unique, and $L(\mathfrak m+\mathfrak n)$ is a subquotient of $L(\mathfrak m)\times L(\mathfrak n)$.
GlobalTheory.Published.StandardCosocleGL: Over a non-archimedean local field of characteristic $0$, a product of segment representations in standard order has a unique irreducible quotient.
GlobalTheory.Published.IrreducibleAdmiss: Every irreducible smooth complex representation of $\GL_n$ over a non-archimedean local field is admissible.
GlobalTheory.Published.StandardFunctorsF: Over a non-archimedean local field, Jacquet functors and parabolic induction for block parabolic subgroups of $\GL_n$ preserve finite length.
GlobalTheory.Published.TemperedProductOf: Over a non-archimedean local field of characteristic $0$, an irreducible smooth representation of $\GL_N$ is tempered exactly when it is a product of square-integrable representations.
GlobalTheory.Published.CasselmanWallach: For a real unitary group and an irreducible unitary representation $\sigma$: every $(\mathfrak g,K)$-map from the $K$-finite vectors of $\sigma$ to a smooth Fr\'echet representation of moderate growth extends uniquely to a continuous map on smooth vectors.
GlobalTheory.Published.ChebotarevDegreeO: For a finite Galois extension $L/F$ of number fields, $g\in\Gal(L/F)$ and a finite set $S$ of primes, there is a prime outside $S$ of degree one over $\Q$, unramified in $L$, with Frobenius $g$.
GlobalTheory.Published.ChowFormExists: In characteristic $0$, a geometrically prime homogeneous ideal of dimension $D+1$ has a Chow form of degree equal to its Hilbert degree, unique up to a non-zero scalar.
GlobalTheory.Published.ClozelCohomologic: Over a totally complex field, every regular algebraic cuspidal automorphic representation of $\GL_a$ is cohomological.
GlobalTheory.Published.ClozelPurity: Over a totally complex field, for a cuspidal representation of $\GL_a$ with algebraic infinitesimal characters there is an integer $w_0$ with $\mathrm{infChar}(\bar\tau)=w_0-\mathrm{infChar}(\tau)$ for every embedding $\tau$.
GlobalTheory.Published.ComplexMultiplica: For $K$ imaginary quadratic there are a Hilbert class field $H\subset\C$ and an Artin isomorphism $\mathrm{Cl}(K)\cong\Gal(H/K)$ with $K(j(\mathfrak a))=H$ and $\mathrm{art}([\mathfrak b])\,j(\mathfrak a)=j(\mathfrak b^{-1}\mathfrak a)$.
GlobalTheory.Published.CuspBounded: On the adelic unitary group of a Hermitian space over a CM field, a smooth cuspidal automorphic function all of whose derivatives have uniform moderate growth is bounded, with all its derivatives.
GlobalTheory.Published.CuspDecayBound: On the same group, a quantitative form: for a given level and exponents, finitely many derivatives bound $\abs{\varphi(g)}\,\mathrm{ht}(g)^N$ for every cusp function of that level.
GlobalTheory.Published.CuspDecaySobolev: On the same group, the rapid-decay seminorms of a cusp function of given level are bounded by its Sobolev seminorms of moderate growth.
GlobalTheory.Published.CuspRapidDecay: On the same group, every smooth cuspidal automorphic function of uniform moderate growth decays rapidly.
GlobalTheory.Published.CuspTraceClass: On the same group, for every smooth compactly supported $f$ the operator $R_{\mathrm{cusp}}(f)$ on the cuspidal $L^2$-space is of trace class.
GlobalTheory.Published.CuspidalMirabolic: For every finite field, $\GL_{n+1}$ has an irreducible cuspidal complex representation, and the restriction of such a representation to the mirabolic subgroup is the induced representation of a non-degenerate character.
GlobalTheory.Published.CuspidalSpectrumG: For $\GL_a$ over a totally complex field: the cuspidal part of $L^2$ is a Hilbert direct sum of irreducible subrepresentations, with statements on their finite vectors and on boundedness of cusp forms.
GlobalTheory.Published.CycleHeights: Arithmetic heights and arithmetic intersection functionals exist, are multilinear in mixed arguments, and satisfy a projection formula for heights.
GlobalTheory.Published.DepthZeroJacquetI: Over a non-archimedean local field, for an irreducible representation of $\GL_n$ and a standard parabolic subgroup: a vector fixed by the first congruence subgroup and by the integral points of the unipotent radical, whose image in the Jacquet module is zero, is zero.
GlobalTheory.Published.DepthZeroSupport: Over a non-archimedean local field, if an irreducible representation of $\GL_n$ has a non-zero vector fixed by the first congruence subgroup, so has every member of its cuspidal support.
GlobalTheory.Published.DiscreteSeriesCla: For the real unitary groups $\U(p,q)$: every Harish-Chandra parameter carries an irreducible unitary square-integrable representation with that infinitesimal character and a unique lowest $K$-type, with stated uniqueness.
GlobalTheory.Published.DiscreteSeriesCov: For the double cover of $\U(p,q)$ defined by a square root of the determinant: the discrete series is a family $D(\lambda)$ indexed by parameters, with prescribed $K$-types, and every discrete series representation is equivalent to one of them.
For that double cover and every parameter $\lambda$ there is a discrete series representation with parameter $\lambda$.
GlobalTheory.Published.DiscreteSeriesHer: Two discrete series representations of $\U(p,q)$ with the same Harish-Chandra parameter, transported to the unitary group of a Hermitian matrix by two frames, are unitarily equivalent.
GlobalTheory.Published.DiscreteSeriesLow: In a discrete series representation of $\U(p,q)$ with Harish-Chandra parameter $\lambda$, the $K$-type of highest weight $\lambda+\rho_n-\rho_c$ occurs with multiplicity one, with a second clause on its uniqueness.
GlobalTheory.Published.DiscreteSeriesUpq: For every Harish-Chandra parameter $\lambda$ of $\U(p,q)$ there is an irreducible unitary representation with square-integrable matrix coefficients that contains the $K$-type $\lambda+\rho_n-\rho_c$, with a clause on its other $K$-types.
GlobalTheory.Published.DixmierMalliavinF: For a group closed in $\GL_n(\C)$ with a Haar measure, every smooth compactly supported function is a finite sum of convolutions of two such functions, the first supported in a prescribed neighbourhood of the identity.
GlobalTheory.Published.SiegelEisensteinC: For a Hermitian space $V$ of positive rank over a CM extension, the Siegel Eisenstein series on the doubled group $\U(V\oplus-V)$ attached to a section of the degenerate principal series continues meromorphically, with poles of finite order.
GlobalTheory.Published.DoublingMethodLoc: The preceding statement together with the basic identity of the doubling method.
GlobalTheory.Published.FlathTensorProduc: Every irreducible unitary representation of the adelic unitary group of a Hermitian space over a CM extension is a restricted tensor product of irreducible unitary representations of the local groups.
GlobalTheory.Published.UnitaryIrreducibl: Every irreducible unitary representation of a non-archimedean local unitary group of that kind is admissible.
GlobalTheory.Published.FlathFactorisatio: The factorisation of \lean{FlathTensorProduct}, with the local factors unramified at almost all places.
GlobalTheory.Published.FontaineBcris: Seven properties of Fontaine's ring $B_{\mathrm{cris}}$, among them injectivity of Frobenius and of $B_{\mathrm{cris}}\to B_{\mathrm{dR}}$ and the fundamental exact sequence.
GlobalTheory.Published.FormalAlgebraisat: Grothendieck's algebraisation over a complete noetherian ring, for morphisms from a proper scheme and for schemes.
GlobalTheory.Published.FormalDegreeCompa: With the Haar measure of $\U(p,q)$ normalised through the compact dual, the formal degree of the discrete series representation with Harish-Chandra parameter $\lambda$ is given by the product formula in the differences $\lambda_a-\lambda_b$.
GlobalTheory.Published.GKGlobalisation: For unitary representations of $\U(p,q)$: the closure of an admissible $(\mathfrak g,K)$-submodule is stable under the group, and infinitesimally equivalent irreducible unitary representations are unitarily equivalent.
GlobalTheory.Published.GLHoweDuality: For $n,n'\ge1$, the polynomial functions on $n\times n'$ matrices decompose under $\GL_n(\C)\times\GL_{n'}(\C)$, and under $\U(n)\times\U(n')$, as the multiplicity-free sum of the $F_n^{a}\otimes F_{n'}^{a}$.
UpperTheory.GalS.CuspUAlt: For a CM field $E$ and a regular algebraic cuspidal representation $\pi$ of $\GL_a$ polarised by a Hecke character, there is a continuous semisimple $r\colon G_E\to\GL_a(\overline{\Q}_\ell)$ attached to $\pi$ with stated compatibilities.
GlobalTheory.Published.GenericUnitaryDua: Over a non-archimedean local field of characteristic $0$, every irreducible unitarisable generic representation of $\GL_N$ is a product of unitary segment representations and of complementary pairs.
GlobalTheory.Published.GeometricLemmaFil: The filtration half of the geometric lemma for $\GL_n$ over a non-archimedean local field.
GlobalTheory.Published.GoodChernWeil: For a metric that is good in Mumford's sense, Chern--Weil integrals compute Chern numbers, with a push-forward formula on flag bundles.
GlobalTheory.Published.GreenCuspidal: The cuspidal characters of $\GL_d(\F_p)$ are parametrised without repetition by the monic irreducible polynomials of degree $d$ with non-zero constant term, each of degree $\prod_{i=1}^{d-1}(p^i-1)$.
GlobalTheory.Published.GreenRegularChara: For $K=\F_{p^d}$, each regular character $\theta$ of $K^\times$ gives a cuspidal character of $\GL_d(\F_p)$ of degree $\prod_{i=1}^{d-1}(p^i-1)$ with value $(-1)^{d-1}\sum_i\theta(z^{p^i})$ on elements with irreducible characteristic polynomial; $\tau(\theta)=\tau(\theta')$ exactly for Frobenius conjugates; and every cuspidal character arises.
GlobalTheory.Published.GreenSeriesSt: For a prime $p$ and $N\ge1$ there is a map from square-free polynomials of degree $N$ to irreducible characters of $\GL_N(\F_p)$ with stated properties.
GlobalTheory.Published.AbelianLifting: For a surjection of rings whose kernel has nilpotent divided powers, abelian schemes and their homomorphisms lift according to the Hodge filtration in crystalline cohomology.
GlobalTheory.Published.GrothendieckDefor: For every surjection of rings with nilpotent divided-power kernel: the Grothendieck--Messing statement on canonicity of the comparison and on lifting abelian schemes and their homomorphisms.
GlobalTheory.Published.GrothendieckMessi: The same for rings in which a prime $p$ is nilpotent.
GlobalTheory.Published.principalPolarisa: For a principally polarised abelian variety over an algebraically closed field, the space of sections of the polarising line bundle is one-dimensional.
GlobalTheory.Published.HarishChandraAnal: Matrix coefficients of $K$-finite vectors in admissible representations of $\U(p,q)$ are real-analytic, with a density statement for Levi subgroups.
GlobalTheory.Published.HarishChandraFini: On the adelic unitary group of a Hermitian space over a CM extension, the automorphic forms of a given level, archimedean $K$-type and infinitesimal character span a finite-dimensional space.
GlobalTheory.Published.HarishChandraModu: For the double covers of $\U(p,q)$: the Harish-Chandra module of an irreducible unitary representation exists, is admissible and irreducible, and determines the representation; $K$-finite vectors are analytic.
GlobalTheory.Published.HasseNormSt: For a number field $F$ and $\delta,x\ne0$: if $x=a^2-\delta b^2$ is solvable at every real place and in every non-archimedean completion, it is solvable in $F$.
GlobalTheory.Published.HeckeLAdicCharact: For every number field there is a global Artin map, and for every algebraic Hecke character and every $\ell$ a unique continuous $\ell$-adic character attached to it through that map.
The $\ell$-adic character of an algebraic Hecke character is crystalline at every place above $\ell$ at which the Hecke character is unramified.

At the places above $\ell$, the $\ell$-adic character of an algebraic Hecke character is de Rham, potentially crystalline, and crystalline where the Hecke character is unramified, with the expected Hodge--Tate weights.
GlobalTheory.Published.HeckeLAdicParamet: At a place $w$ above $\ell$, the Weil--Deligne representation given by Fontaine's $D_{\mathrm{pst}}$ for the $\ell$-adic character of an algebraic Hecke character is its local component composed with local class field theory.
GlobalTheory.Published.HeckeLEntireAndNo: For a unitary Hecke character $\chi$ of a number field: if $\chi$ is not a power of the norm, $L(s,\chi)$ is entire; and if $\chi\ne1$, $L(1,\chi)\ne0$.
GlobalTheory.Published.HeckeLPartialCont: For a number field and a finite set $T$ of places: the $L$-function with the Euler factors at $T$ removed of a unitary Hecke character that is not a power of the norm is entire and non-zero on $\re s\ge1$; and $(s-1)\zeta_K^{T}(s)$ is entire and non-zero there.
GlobalTheory.Published.HermitianHassePri: For a quadratic extension of number fields, two non-degenerate Hermitian matrices that are congruent over every completion are congruent.
GlobalTheory.Published.HermitianLocalGlo: Locally, over a quadratic extension of non-archimedean local fields with $2\ne0$, two non-degenerate Hermitian forms of the same rank are congruent exactly when the ratio of their determinants is a norm; with a global statement over CM fields.
GlobalTheory.Published.HolomorphicDiscre: A discrete series representation of $\U(p,q)$ with Harish-Chandra parameter in the holomorphic chamber is a lowest-weight module.
GlobalTheory.Published.HoweDualityReal: For a unitary dual pair over a CM extension, Howe duality at the archimedean places in the polynomial Fock model of the Weil representation.
GlobalTheory.Published.IdealInvariantsOn: For $K$ imaginary quadratic and a lattice homothetic to a fractional ideal, $j$ is algebraic over $K$ and its orbit under $\mathrm{Aut}(\C/K)$ is the set of $j$-invariants of all ideal lattices.
GlobalTheory.Published.InducedSimpleLowe: For $\GL_N$ in characteristic $p$ and a dominant weight $\lambda$ with $\lambda_i-\lambda_j+(j-i)\le p$ for $i<j$, the induced module $\nabla(\lambda)$ is non-zero and simple.
GlobalTheory.Published.JacquetShalika: The rigidity statement \lean{JacquetShalikaRigidity} together with a bound on Satake parameters of cuspidal representations.
GlobalTheory.Published.KFiniteVectorsUni: Every irreducible unitary representation of $\U(p,q)$ is admissible; its $K$-finite vectors are analytic, dense, stable under the Lie algebra and irreducible as a $(\mathfrak g,K)$-module.
GlobalTheory.Published.KawamataViehweg: For a smooth projective variety $X$ over an algebraically closed field of characteristic $0$ and a nef and big line bundle $N$: $H^q(X,K_X\otimes N)=0$ for $q>0$.
GlobalTheory.Published.KudlaSplittingSpl: For a quadratic extension of non-archimedean local fields of characteristic $0$, a Hermitian matrix $Q$ and a character $\chi$ of $E^\times$ restricting to the right power of the quadratic character: a smooth unitary representation of the split unitary group $\mathrm{U}(\nu,\nu)$ itself on the Schwartz space of the Schrödinger model, compatible with the Heisenberg action attached to $Q$ and given on the Levi subgroup by the usual formula.
GlobalTheory.Published.L2ExtensionLogCan: An extension theorem of Ohsawa--Takegoshi type with $L^2$ estimates, from a finite non-degenerate common zero set of $n$ sections of a line bundle on a compact complex manifold of dimension $n$.
GlobalTheory.Published.LandherrSt: For a CM field, two non-degenerate Hermitian matrices with the same signature at every embedding and with determinants differing by a norm are congruent.
GlobalTheory.Published.Linnik: There are $C,L>0$ such that for coprime $a,q\ge1$ the least prime $p\equiv a\pmod q$ is at most $C\,q^{L}$.
GlobalTheory.Published.CuspidalMultiplic: Over a totally complex field, two cuspidal automorphic subrepresentations of $\GL_a$ in the same isomorphism class have the same space.
UpperTheory.GalS.CarUAlt: For a CM field $E$ and a conjugate self-dual regular algebraic cuspidal representation of $\GL_a$, $a\ge2$: the attached $r\colon G_E\to\GL_a(\overline{\Q}_\ell)$ exists with the compatibilities of \lean{CuspUAlt} and with stated properties at the places above $\ell$.
GlobalTheory.Published.MetaplecticRepres: For every $n$ there is a two-sheeted covering group of $\mathrm{Sp}_{2n}(\R)$ with a unitary representation on $L^2(\R^n)$, continuous on Schwartz space and compatible with the Schr\"odinger representation of the Heisenberg group.
GlobalTheory.Published.MoyPrasadJacquetI: Over a non-archimedean local field, for an admissible representation of $\GL_n$ and a standard parabolic subgroup: the vectors fixed by the first congruence subgroup and the integral points of the unipotent radical map bijectively onto the corresponding fixed vectors of the Jacquet module.
GlobalTheory.Published.NadelVanishingAnd: Nadel vanishing for a pair, and the existence of a divisor with an isolated non-klt point, on a normal projective complex variety.
GlobalTheory.Published.NefNumerics: Over an algebraically closed field: intersection numbers of nef line bundles are non-negative; a nef line bundle is big exactly when its top self-intersection is positive; and an asymptotic Riemann--Roch statement for nef bundles.
GlobalTheory.Published.PointSeparationPa: An effective criterion of Angehrn--Siu type for a line bundle on a klt pair to separate two points of a normal projective complex variety.
GlobalTheory.Published.PoitouTateNormali: Poitou--Tate duality with normalised local invariant maps, for finite modules over a number field and a set of primes containing those above $\ell$.
GlobalTheory.Published.PrismaticDieudonn: For a complete algebraically closed field of mixed characteristic, a prismatic Dieudonn\'e functor from $p$-divisible groups over its ring of integers to finite free $A_{\inf}$-modules, with its Hodge-theoretic properties.
GlobalTheory.Published.QuadraticClassFie: Class field theory for quadratic extensions of number fields: local norm-residue characters, the Hasse norm theorem, an exact sequence and the product formula, with a compatibility in towers.
GlobalTheory.Published.RadfordShufflePol: In characteristic $0$, the shuffle algebra on an ordered alphabet is the polynomial algebra on the Lyndon words.
GlobalTheory.Published.SiegelWeilUnitary: The Siegel--Weil formula for unitary groups in the convergent range, for Hermitian spaces of ranks $n<m\le2n$ satisfying Weil's condition: the theta integral converges and equals the value of a Siegel Eisenstein series.
GlobalTheory.Published.WeilThetaConverge: Weil's criterion: if $V$ is anisotropic or $n+r(V)<\dim V$, the theta integral over $[\U(V)]$ of every adelic Schwartz function on $V^n$ converges absolutely.
GlobalTheory.Published.RallisInnerProduc: The Rallis inner product formula in the convergent range, for theta lifts between unitary groups of ranks $n<m\le2n$ under Weil's condition.
GlobalTheory.Published.RayCharacterArtin: A homomorphism from the ideals prime to $\mathfrak m$ to an abelian group that is trivial on principal ideals generated by elements congruent to $1$ modulo $\mathfrak m$ is given by a unique continuous character of the Galois group, unramified outside $\mathfrak m$, through Frobenius elements.
GlobalTheory.Published.RayClassFieldSt: Existence of the ray class field of a number field for a non-zero ideal, with its Artin map.
GlobalTheory.Published.RealMetaplecticRe: A topological double cover of $\mathrm{Sp}_{2n}(\R)$ with a strongly continuous unitary representation on $L^2(\R^n)$ in which the non-trivial element of the kernel acts by $-1$, compatible with the Schr\"odinger representation and preserving Schwartz space.
GlobalTheory.Published.RegularAlgebraicP: For a CM field, a regular algebraic cuspidal automorphic representation of $\GL_a$ has pure infinity type and is cohomological.
GlobalTheory.Published.SchurOrthogonalit: For a unimodular locally compact group and an irreducible unitary representation with one non-zero square-integrable matrix coefficient: all matrix coefficients are square-integrable and satisfy the Schur orthogonality relations with a formal degree.
GlobalTheory.Published.SemiAbelianHomExt: Over a noetherian normal scheme, a homomorphism of semi-abelian schemes defined over a dense open extends uniquely.
GlobalTheory.Published.SemiAbelianLieSem: For a semi-abelian scheme $G$ over a smooth projective curve in characteristic $0$, every subbundle of $\mathrm{Lie}\,G$ has non-positive degree.
GlobalTheory.Published.SemistableReducti: Every polarised abelian variety over a finite extension of $\Q_p$ acquires a semi-abelian model over the integers of a finite extension.
GlobalTheory.Published.SerreHolomorphicS: On a smooth projective complex variety, algebraic sections of a line bundle are the same as holomorphic sections.
GlobalTheory.Published.UnusedSlot72: The proposition \lean{True}; an empty slot of the file.
GlobalTheory.Published.SiegelSetUnitary: For a non-degenerate Hermitian form over a CM extension: an Iwasawa decomposition of the adelic unitary group and a Siegel set with the properties of reduction theory.
GlobalTheory.Published.SiegelToroidalInt: For $g\ge1$ and odd $n\ge3$: the Siegel moduli scheme of level $n$ over $\Z[1/n,\zeta_n]$ has a smooth projective toroidal compactification carrying a semi-abelian scheme that extends the universal abelian scheme.
GlobalTheory.Published.SiegelWeilUnitary: The Siegel--Weil formula in the Schr\"odinger model of $\U(n,n)$, for $n<\dim V\le2n$ under Weil's condition.
GlobalTheory.Published.SquareIntegrableS: Over a non-archimedean local field of characteristic $0$, every irreducible square-integrable representation of $\GL_n$ is the representation $L(\Delta)$ of a segment.
GlobalTheory.Published.StoneVonNeumann: For a symplectic space over a non-archimedean local field of characteristic not $2$: the Heisenberg group has an irreducible smooth representation with a given non-trivial central character, unique up to isomorphism.
GlobalTheory.Published.StrongApproxSU: Strong approximation for the special unitary group of a non-degenerate Hermitian form of rank at least $2$ over a CM extension, with respect to a set of places at which the group is not compact.
GlobalTheory.Published.ThetaRationalInva: A statement in the archive's own terms: invariance of spaces of theta functions on CM tori under rational unitary matrices, up to an explicit character.
GlobalTheory.Published.ToroidalCompactif: For a unitary moduli problem of PEL type over a CM field: a projective model containing the moduli space as a dense open, smooth of the expected dimension, with boundary a divisor with simple normal crossings and a logarithmic Kodaira--Spencer isomorphism.
GlobalTheory.Published.ToroidalForFanKS: The same for a prescribed polarised admissible fan without self-intersection, with toroidal charts along the boundary.
GlobalTheory.Published.TotallyDisjointPr: Over a non-archimedean local field: if no member of the cuspidal support of $\pi_1$ is $\nu^{j}$ times a member of that of $\pi_2$ for $j\in\{-1,0,1\}$, then $\pi_1\times\pi_2$ is irreducible.
GlobalTheory.Published.UnlinkedProductIr: Over a non-archimedean local field: if no member of the cuspidal support of $\pi_1$ is an unramified twist of a member of that of $\pi_2$, then $\pi_1\times\pi_2$ is irreducible.
GlobalTheory.Published.UnramifiedDoublin: Over a non-archimedean local field of characteristic $0$, for an unramified representation of $\GL_n$ the doubling zeta integral of the normalised spherical section against the zonal spherical function converges for $\re s$ large and is given by the expected quotient of local $L$-factors.
GlobalTheory.Published.VolGe: For a Hermitian line bundle on an arithmetic variety that is nef on fibres with semipositive metric, the arithmetic volume is at least the arithmetic self-intersection number.
GlobalTheory.Published.VolNef: For an arithmetically nef Hermitian line bundle, the arithmetic volume equals the arithmetic self-intersection number.
GlobalTheory.Published.WeberRayFieldSt: For $K$ imaginary quadratic of discriminant less than $-4$, the field generated over $K$ by the values of the Weber function at the $n$-torsion points of $\C/\cO_K$ is the ray class field of conductor $n$.
GlobalTheory.Published.WeilRepresentatio: For a Hermitian and a skew-Hermitian space over a CM extension and Hecke characters with the right restrictions, a Weil representation of the product of the two adelic unitary groups exists.
The same in the notation of the archive's base data.
GlobalTheory.Published.WeilSiegelFormula: Weil's formula for unitary groups: under Weil's condition the theta integral is bounded by a continuous seminorm and converges, and in the range $2n<m$ it equals the Siegel Eisenstein series.
GlobalTheory.Published.WeylBranching: The restriction to $\GL_n(\C)$, and to $\U(n)$, of the irreducible representation of $\GL_{n+1}(\C)$ of highest weight $\lambda$ is the multiplicity-free sum over the weights interlacing $\lambda$.
GlobalTheory.Published.DualAbelianScheme: Every abelian scheme has a dual abelian scheme of the same relative dimension, with a Poincar\'e bundle exhibiting each as the dual of the other.
GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory.Ar.GR.Zarhi: Over the valuation ring of an algebraically closed non-archimedean field, an abelian scheme with a relatively ample line bundle is a retract of a principally polarised one.
GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory.Ar.HT.Fargu: For a $p$-divisible group over the ring of integers of a complete algebraically closed field of characteristic $0$: the kernel of the Hodge--Tate map is the annihilator, under the pairing induced by the Weil pairing, of the corresponding part of the dual.
GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory.Ar.Pub.NefR: An asymptotic Riemann--Roch statement for a divisor class that is nef on the generic fibre of an arithmetic variety: $D!\,\dim H^0(\tau a)/\tau^{D}$ tends to the generic degree.
GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory.Hypotheses₂: A Poincar\'e--Lelong formula on an arithmetic variety: the integral of $\log\norm{s}$ against Chern forms equals a sum over the horizontal components of the divisor of $s$, with a correction.

For a smooth separated quasi-compact scheme over a field of characteristic $0$, an ideal sheaf and a divisor with simple normal crossings: a sequence of blow-ups in smooth centres having normal crossings with the divisor makes the ideal an effective Cartier divisor with simple normal crossings.

Every reduced separated scheme of finite type over a field of characteristic $0$ has a resolution by a sequence of blow-ups that is an isomorphism over the smooth locus, the preimage of the singular locus being a divisor with simple normal crossings.
GlobalTheory.TwSys.Cheb: For a number field $F$, an open normal subgroup $U$ of $G_F$, $g\in G_F$ and a finite set of primes: there is a prime outside the set, of degree one and unramified over $\Q$, with inertia in $U$ and a Frobenius in $gU$.
GlobalTheory.ThK.Dbl.EisBL: Siegel Eisenstein series on the doubled unitary group attached to standard sections converge in a half-plane and continue meromorphically, with poles of finite order.
GlobalTheory.ThK.Dbl.SiegelWeilStd: The Siegel--Weil formula for a definite Hermitian or skew-Hermitian space: the Siegel Eisenstein series is holomorphic at $s_0=(m-n)/2$ and its value there is a constant times the theta integral.
A statement in the archive's own terms: theta integrals attached to matched data agree up to explicit constants.
ReciprocityTheory.Gal.GlobalEulerChar: For a finite $\ell^r$-torsion Galois module $M$ over a number field unramified outside $S$: Tate's global Euler characteristic formula.
ReciprocityTheory.Gal.GlobalFiniteness: For a finite $\ell^r$-torsion Galois module $M$ as above: $H^0$, $H^1$ and $H^2$ are finite and the higher groups vanish for $\ell\ne2$.
ReciprocityTheory.Gal.LocalEulerChar: For a finite $\ell^r$-torsion Galois module $M$ at a finite place: Tate's local Euler characteristic formula.
ReciprocityTheory.Gal.LocalFiniteness: For a finite $\ell^r$-torsion Galois module $M$ at a finite place: $H^0$, $H^1$ and $H^2$ are finite and the higher groups vanish.
ReciprocityTheory.Gal.LocalTateDuality: For a finite $\ell^r$-torsion Galois module $M$ at a finite place: Tate local duality.
ReciprocityTheory.Gal.GreenbergWiles: For a finite $\ell^r$-torsion Galois module $M$ and local conditions: the formula of Greenberg and Wiles comparing a Selmer group with the dual Selmer group.
ReciprocityTheory.Gal.UnramifiedOrthogon: For a finite $\ell^r$-torsion Galois module $M$ at a place not above $\ell$ where $M$ is unramified: the unramified classes of $M$ and of its Tate dual are exact annihilators.
HeckeCharacterZeroLocus.SiegelWeilU.Sieg: For a non-degenerate Hermitian form of rank $M$ over a CM extension: $[\U(J)]$ has finite volume, and for $2n<M$ the mean of the theta series of frames with a given Gram matrix is the product of the local densities.
Formalism.GaloisCohomology.LocalEulerCha: For $K/\Q_\ell$ finite and a finite continuous $\ell^r$-torsion module: $\#H^1=\#H^0\cdot\#H^2\cdot\#M^{[K:\Q_\ell]}$.
Formalism.GaloisCohomology.LocalFinitene: For $K/\Q_\ell$ finite and such a module: $H^0$, $H^1$, $H^2$ are finite and $H^n=0$ for $n\ge3$.
Formalism.GaloisCohomology.LocalTateDual: For $K/\Q_\ell$ finite: $H^2(G_K,\mu_{\ell^r})\cong\Z/\ell^r$ and the cup-product pairings with the Tate dual are perfect.
UpperTheory.EveryCharacter: The conclusion: $L(s,\chi)\ne0$ for every Dirichlet character $\chi$ and every $s$ with $\re s>\tfrac12$, $s=1$ excluded for trivial $\chi$. The file returns it under the hypothesis of \cref{st:vwin}.
